description: This file implements a source for Kubernetes pod configurations, watching a specified file or directory for changes, parsing pod manifests, and updating a cache store accordingly.

classes.name: sourceFile
classes.description: Represents a source of pod configurations from a file or directory, with methods to list, parse, and watch for changes.

methods.name: NewSourceFile
methods.description: Initializes and starts watching a config file or directory for pod configuration changes.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Starts the background process to periodically list config and handle watch events.

methods.name: listConfig
methods.description: Reads the config path, detects if it's a directory or file, and updates the store with parsed pods.

methods.name: extractFromDir
methods.description: Parses all pod manifests in a directory.

methods.name: extractFromFile
methods.description: Parses a single file for a pod manifest.

methods.name: replaceStore
methods.description: Replaces the current store contents with the provided pods.
